record.oneLiner: An Early Jurassic predator with a pair of head crests.
record.description: Dilophosaurus was a theropod predator of Early Jurassic North America, about 7 m long, named for the pair of thin crests on its skull. It was one of the earliest large predatory dinosaurs.

notableFacts.text: Named for the pair of thin, arching crests on its skull.
Portrayed with a frill and venom in Jurassic Park — both fictional.
